subject.title: Feature request: auto-update for skills and plugins

question: Should OpenClaw add unattended auto-update for installed ClawHub skills and plugins, and what trust, pinning, rollback, audit, and operator-control policy must gate it?
rationale: The implementation is feasible, but it changes third-party code execution, public config, startup lifecycle, and supply-chain trust boundaries that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Design a gated opt-in updater
options.body: Add the feature only after maintainers define provenance checks, installPolicy integration, pinning or allowed ranges, rollback, audit logs, and failure behavior.

options.title: Keep explicit updates only
options.body: Leave manual skills/plugins update commands as the supported path and document external scheduling for operators who accept the risk.

options.title: Split security prerequisites first
options.body: Track signing, rollback, provenance, and runtime trust enforcement as prerequisite work before deciding on background automation.

recommendation.title: Design a gated opt-in updater
recommendation.body: Add the feature only after maintainers define provenance checks, installPolicy integration, pinning or allowed ranges, rollback, audit logs, and failure behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature history across package auto-update, native ClawHub install, and plugin update command boundaries.
